transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because I've just gotten so... slowed down lately. I'm an auditor, and it's gotten to the point where I can sit staring at a single workpaper for twenty minutes before I even move my hand to type. People at work have started noticing that I'm not keeping up with things, so I figured I needed to come in.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?
Yeah, I have. Most days, I just wake up with this... heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It honestly just feels like the day is already lost before I've even managed to get out of bed.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

No, not really. I used to do a lot of different things—like, I'd plan hikes, take photos, cook big meals on Sundays, and I even volunteered at the library. But now... I don't know, those things just feel like items on a checklist. I just don't care enough to even start them anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been about seven months now. It started right around the time my husband stopped working... his company had some downsizing, and he lost his job. Since then, I've just been feeling like this.
Have you been experiencing any feelings of worry or anxiety lately?
Not really. I mean, I don't feel anxious or worried about things. It's more just... that empty feeling I mentioned. I don't really have the energy to worry, to be honest.
Have you been enjoying time spent with friends and family lately?

Not really. It's kind of like what I was saying about the other stuff. I used to love having people over or going out, but now... it just feels like another chore. It's like the hikes or the cooking I mentioned before. I just don't have the interest or the energy to engage with anyone right now.
Have you noticed any changes in your physical activity level or movement?

Yeah, I have. I've just gotten so slowed down. I'm an auditor, and lately... well, I can sit there staring at one audit workpaper for twenty minutes before I even move my hand to type. It's like I just can't get my body to move. It's actually a big part of why I'm here, because people at work have started noticing that I'm not keeping up.
Have you experienced any thoughts of death or suicidal ideation?

No, I haven't. I mean, I feel completely empty and drained all the time, but I don't want to die. I haven't had any thoughts about hurting myself or anything like that. It's just... I just feel stuck, not suicidal.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite or sleep patterns lately?

Yeah, definitely with my appetite. Food has mostly just become something I force down because I know I should eat. I've actually noticed my work skirts have gotten pretty loose lately, even though I'm not trying to lose weight at all. As for sleep, I haven't really noticed as much of a change there, but my appetite is just gone.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt somewhat better, or has it been a constant feeling of being down?

No, there haven't really been any better days. It's just... constant. Most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling right in my chest. It's like the whole day is already lost before I've even managed to get out of bed. It just stays like that, all day, every day.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating on things like reading or watching TV?

Not really, no. I mean... I can still sit and watch a show or read a book just fine. I haven't noticed any issues with my focus, even with my work. It's just the lack of energy, like I mentioned, but my concentration itself seems completely normal.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt nearly normal, even if only for a few hours?
No, not really. It's just like I said before, it's pretty much constant. I don't get a few hours where it lifts or anything. It's just that same heavy feeling all the time.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt even slightly better for more than a few hours?
No, like I was just saying, it really doesn't let up at all. I haven't had any stretches of time where I felt even a little bit better. It's just a constant low, day in and day out.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure or enjoyment in?

Not really. I used to do a lot of things... I'd plan hikes on the weekends, take photos, spend my Sundays cooking meals for the week. I even volunteered at the library. But now... I just don't care. All of those things just feel like items on a checklist that I don't have the energy or the desire to even start. I don't get any enjoyment out of them anymore.
Have you been feeling restless or fidgety, or have you noticed yourself moving more slowly than usual?

I haven't been restless at all, it's actually the opposite. I've gotten so slowed down lately. It's a big part of why I finally came in... I can just sit there staring at one audit workpaper for twenty minutes before I even move my hand to type. It's like I just can't get going. And people at work have actually started noticing that I'm not keeping up with my usual pace.
Do you feel noticeably worse in the morning?

I don't think so. I mean, it's pretty much the same all day. Waking up is hard because I just don't want to face the day, but I wouldn't say the feeling itself is worse in the morning. It's just... consistently heavy from the time I wake up until I go to sleep.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past seven months?

Yeah, I have. I haven't been weighing myself to know the exact amount, but my work skirts have gotten pretty loose lately, and I'm definitely not trying to lose weight. It's just that food has mostly become something I force down because I know I should eat, not because I actually have any appetite for it.
Do you think you've been moving more slowly than usual or have trouble getting started with activities?

I think we just talked about that a minute ago, actually. But yes, like I mentioned, I've definitely been moving a lot slower. Getting started on anything... like those workpapers I was talking about... it just takes a huge amount of effort to get going right now.
Have you felt like you're moving more slowly than usual most of the time over the past seven months?

Yeah, like I was just saying... yes, it's been that way for the whole seven months. It's actually a big part of why I finally came in. I've gotten so slowed down that I can sit staring at one audit workpaper for twenty minutes before I even move my hand to type anything. And people at work have started noticing that I'm just not keeping up. So, yes.
Have you been feeling restless or fidgety lately?
No, not really. I don't feel restless at all. If anything, it's the exact opposite, like I was just saying. I just feel... stuck, and slow. I don't have the energy to be fidgety.
